assessment: Bitcoin direction succeeded at both twelve and eighteen months, with a substantial intervening gain reversal. The APD analysis underweighted concentrated project and capital-allocation risk despite durable legacy operations. Brazil current-account support was factually reversed. Long-horizon China, APD and gold-relative calls remain open.
